title: Dispatch: fail closed on unresolved ambiguity gate; tighten citation marker (attempt 5)
description:
Second review-response dispatch for eshyra-jw56, correcting attempt 4
(eshyra-us0u). The reviewer accepted attempt 4's schema and validator work and
**overruled its runtime behaviour**. Read `bd show eshyra-jw56` and
`bd show eshyra-us0u` for context.

Worktree: `.worktrees/<this-bead-id>`, branch `<this-bead-id>`, cut from the
current tip of `eshyra-jw56` (which carries attempt 4). Work only there.

## P1 — an ambiguity gate must fail closed, not default

Attempt 4 made an ambiguity-gated `resetsDuration` fall back to preserving the
deadline and reported the ambiguity id on a **successful** transition result.
That is still a resolution. By the time the id surfaces, the runtime has already
chosen an interpretation, spent charges, committed a timer deadline, and written
all of it into replayable campaign history. A later campaign ruling that
same-face presses do reset would make that committed state wrong and not
recoverable without rewriting history.

The contract treats an ambiguity as a **gate**, not a default: no canonical
resolution, campaign-ruling ownership, resolvable only by campaign-owned prose
outside the pack.

### Required behaviour

Selecting a transition whose `resetsDuration` carries an unresolved
`source-ambiguity` marker must **throw before any mutation** — before charges
are spent, before timers are resolved, and before any item state is written.
Throw from `selectStateTransition` in `packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts`,
which already runs before the cost loop and every write, rather than relying on
transaction rollback.

The failure must be structured, not a bare message. Add an
`ItemStateAmbiguityError` (extending `ItemStateError`, exported the same way)
carrying:

- `ambiguityId`
- `question` (from the mechanics ambiguity block)
- `interpretationIds` (all declared interpretation ids)
- `owner: 'campaign-ruling'`
- plus pack ref and operation id in the message

`selectStateTransition` already receives `mechanics`, so the ambiguity block is
in scope. Remove `unresolvedAmbiguityIds` from the successful
`UseItemResult['transition']` shape — the ambiguity is surfaced in the failure,
never in a success.

Scope of the block is exact: only an operation selecting a transition that
carries an unresolved gate fails. Different-face presses, `spell-contact-loss`,
`press-face-6`, timer expiry, and every other Cube behaviour stay executable.

### Tests

- Selecting the gated transition throws `ItemStateAmbiguityError` with all four
  fields populated.
- **No mutation on throw**: read the row back after the throw and assert the
  charge economy, `machineState`, and `pendingTimers` are byte-identical to the
  pre-call state. This is the assertion that matters most.
- Literal `resetsDuration: true` still re-anchors (unchanged).
- The unaffected Cube operations still execute.

### Docs

`docs/item-reset-executor.md` must say the gate fails closed pending
campaign-ruling support (epic eshyra-jhpt), replacing whatever attempt 4 wrote
about a provisional preserve default. State that once campaign rulings exist,
runtime will require a recorded choice of one of the declared interpretation ids
and execute accordingly.

## P2 — the citation walker must recognize the exact marker shape

Attempt 4 widened the walker to the whole mechanics subtree (correct) but it
still counts **any** object carrying a string `ambiguityId` as a citation. With
the wider traversal that is accidental coupling: any future field named
`ambiguityId` silently satisfies the "must be cited" rule.

Tighten recognition to the exact marker: an object with
`kind === 'source-ambiguity'` **and** a string `ambiguityId`. An object carrying
`ambiguityId` without that `kind` must not count as a citation.

I verified this is non-breaking: all three citation sites in the committed pack
(`spell:create-undead` x2, `spell:find-familiar` x1) already use exactly
`{ kind: 'source-ambiguity', ambiguityId }`.

Add a test that an `ambiguityId` without the marker `kind` does **not** satisfy
the citation requirement (i.e. the declared ambiguity is still rejected as
uncited).

## P3 — make the field's dual meaning unmistakable

`resetsDuration: true | SourceAmbiguityReference` stays as-is — do **not**
rename it. But the name reads as an assertion when the object form actually
means "whether this resets is unresolved". Make that impossible to misread in:

- the `MagicItemStateMachine` transition type doc comment,
- the validator's error messages for the field,
- the curation comment on the Cube spec.

## Constraints

- Do not resolve the ambiguity in either direction. Do not build a campaign
  ruling facility — only the gate and its structured failure.
- Regenerate only if a curation input changes; the pack should be unchanged by
  this bead. If `records.json` moves, explain exactly why or stop and report.
- Do NOT touch `docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json`.
- `npm ci` first. `npm run verify:worktree` **before** committing. Commit on
  your branch. Do not push, do not open or comment on a PR, do not merge. Never
  modify eshyra-jw56 or eshyra-us0u.
